standard.title: Quel / Quelle / Quels / Quelles (Interrogative Adjective)
standard.explanation: Quel agrees with the noun it modifies. Use quel (masculine singular) / quelle (feminine singular) / quels (masculine plural) / quelles (feminine plural) to ask 'what' or 'which' before a noun. Examples: Quel est ton métier ? (What is your job?) / Quelle est ta profession ? (What is your profession?) / Quels sont tes loisirs ? (What are your hobbies?) / Quelles sont tes langues ? (What languages do you speak?). Quel can also be used as an exclamation: Quelle chance ! (What luck!) / Quel dommage ! (What a shame!)

advanced.title: Quel / Quelle / Quels / Quelles — Agreement, Exclamations & Common Traps
advanced.explanation: Quel has four forms that agree with the noun they modify: quel (masc sing), quelle (fem sing), quels (masc pl), quelles (fem pl). Use quel/quelle/etc. to ask 'what' or 'which' directly before a noun: Quel métier fais-tu ? (What job do you do?) / Quels projets avez-vous ? (What projects do you have?). Quel can also function as an exclamative adjective: Quel dommage ! (What a shame!) / Quelle surprise ! (What a surprise!) / Quels progrès ! (What progress!). Be careful: quel modifies a noun directly, while qu'est-ce que replaces the noun entirely. Compare: Quel métier fait-il ? (Which job does he do?) vs. Qu'est-ce qu'il fait ? (What does he do?). Quel also appears in indirect questions: Je ne sais pas quel métier il choisira. (I don't know which job he will choose.) / Dis-moi quels langues tu parles. (Tell me which languages you speak.)

standard.scenario: You are at a networking event. Introduce yourself with your name and job, then ask a new person about their profession using 'Quel est ton métier ?'
keyPhrases: Depuis combien de temps fais-tu ce travail ?
standard.modelAnswer: Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Sophie. Je suis boulangère. Et toi, quel est ton métier ?
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: This response introduces yourself, states your profession, and asks about the other person's job using the correct form of 'quel' (Quel est ton métier).
standard.tip: Remember to use the correct gender form of your profession (boulanger vs. boulangère). Use 'Quel est ton métier ?' to ask someone's job.

advanced.scenario: You are at a professional conference. Introduce yourself with your name and profession. Ask which jobs interest the other person using 'Quels métiers t'intéressent ?' Then discuss indirect questions about professions and ask about their specialization if applicable.
keyPhrases: Depuis combien de temps exercez-vous cette profession ?
Je ne sais pas quel métier choisir
advanced.modelAnswer: Enchanté ! Je m'appelle Luc, je suis architecte spécialisé en bâtiments écologiques. Quels métiers vous intéressent particulièrement ?
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: This response introduces yourself with a specialization, uses 'Quels métiers' (which jobs) to ask about the other person's interests, and employs formal vous to show professionalism. It also demonstrates using quel in a direct question.
advanced.tip: Use different forms of 'quel' depending on context: 'Quel métier' (singular), 'Quels métiers' (plural). In indirect questions, say 'Je ne sais pas quel métier...' Include your specialization to make the conversation richer.
